src: The Tribune (sworn in Nov 2024, after the state election)

cases.place: Patti police station, Pratapgarh, Uttar Pradesh
cases.head: Dalit man, 22, dies in a police station
cases.text: Arjun, a 22-year-old Dalit man, died in a restroom at Patti police station. His father's complaint led to an FIR with murder and SC/ST Act charges; reports differ on whether police are named in it alongside a family he had a dispute with.
cases.official: Police say he died by suicide. The station officer and a sub-inspector were suspended, and a separate case covers official lapses.

cases.head: Man dies after arrest; six police suspended
cases.text: Dilshad Ansari died after police arrested him at about 2 am in a 2025 drugs case. His family says he was beaten.
cases.official: Police say he jumped from the moving police vehicle. The district police chief suspended six personnel, including the station officer, and said further legal steps would follow NHRC guidelines.

cases.head: Police officer fires on villagers; one man killed
cases.text: A police assistant sub-inspector allegedly fired four rounds from his service pistol at villagers who had confronted and locked him in a room, killing a 50-year-old man and injuring three. He fled after the firing.
cases.official: Madhubani SSP Yogendra Kumar says the officer has been suspended and will be dismissed, a murder case is being registered, five teams are searching for him and a Rs 25,000 reward has been announced.

steps.note: murder case being registered, police say

cases.head: Mob attacks march marking 21 years of RTI
cases.text: A mob attacked a procession by the Mazdoor Kisan Shakti Sangathan (MKSS) marking the 21st anniversary of the Right to Information Act, and activists were assaulted. A local BJP MLA alleged that slogans at the march hurt religious sentiment.
cases.official: The superintendent of police said the procession lacked permission and that further action was under way. Both sides have filed FIRs against each other, the station officer said.

cases.power: A local leader of the ruling Congress
cases.head: Dalit woman allegedly assaulted at a village meeting
cases.text: A local Congress leader is accused of assaulting a Dalit woman, a former village organisation assistant, at a gram sabha. Police registered a case under the BNS and the SC/ST Act.
cases.official: Police registered the case on her complaint; no statement from the accused was reported.

cases.head: Dalit woman allegedly barred from a well and assaulted
cases.text: A Dalit woman says neighbours had stopped her using a well since July and assaulted her on 10 October. Five people were booked under the SC/ST Act and the BNS.
cases.official: Police say the well is on the accused family's premises, that family has filed a counter-complaint, and action will follow the investigation.

cases.head: Taxi driver alleges torture in police station
cases.text: A 32-year-old airport taxi driver alleges police stripped and beat him for hours at Kalady station. A departmental inquiry found he was held from 1 pm to 5 pm without an entry in the General Diary, his family was not told and medical procedures were skipped.
cases.official: The range DIG suspended a sub-inspector, an assistant sub-inspector and two other officers over the lapses. No police account of the alleged assault was reported.

cases.head: Inquiry into alleged torture after Theni jailbreak
cases.text: Seventeen remand prisoners escaped from Theni district jail and were later caught; one alleged in a video that warders tortured them and denied them food and water. On 2 November the State Legal Services Authority ordered an inquiry, including whether the prisoners have since been threatened or coerced.
cases.official: The Chief Minister set up a high-level committee to strengthen prison security; no response to the torture allegations was reported.

cases.place: Prisons in Madurai, Trichy and Tirunelveli districts, Tamil Nadu
cases.head: Court orders probe into Dalit prisoners cleaning toilets
cases.text: A petition alleges prisoners from marginalised communities are kept in separate blocks and made to clean about 150 toilets and do manual scavenging. On 31 August the Madurai Bench of the Madras High Court ordered district judges to inspect the prisons and examine CCTV footage.
cases.official: Prison authorities say municipal services clean the toilets.

cases.head: Blogger dies in police cell; officers on trial
cases.text: Teacher and blogger Albert Ojwang, 30, died in a Nairobi police cell after his arrest over posts about a senior police officer. The state pathologist found head injury, neck compression and other injuries "pointing towards assault".
cases.official: Police first said he hit his head against a cell wall; the Inspector-General later withdrew that statement. The station commander and other officers are on trial for murder.

cases.place: Penha and Alemão favelas, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
cases.head: Rio raid killed 121; no one charged over the deaths
cases.text: A police operation against a drug gang in Rio's Penha and Alemão favelas left 121 people dead, four of them police, the deadliest in Brazil's history. A year on, inquiries into the deaths, including a decapitated body and suspected torture and executions, have not concluded.
cases.official: Police called it a mega-operation against the Comando Vermelho gang. Prosecutors have charged 27 officers with offences such as stealing seized rifles and home invasions, none for the killings; at least 17% of one police unit's body cameras were deliberately switched off, they found.

steps.note: 27, for theft and abuses, not killings

cases.power: National Guard troops on a federal crime task force
cases.head: Man shot dead by National Guard; charges undecided
cases.text: Tyrin Johnson, 20, was shot and killed by Tennessee National Guard troops chasing an armed man in Memphis. Video released on 2 November shows troops training guns on him as he lay dying; his family's autopsy says he was shot in the back.
cases.official: A Guard report says he "rounded on them and pointed a tan handgun at them"; investigators say he was armed. The district attorney has not decided whether to file charges.

cases.place: Baghpat case, heard at the Supreme Court, New Delhi
cases.head: Man kept in jail weeks after Supreme Court bail
cases.text: The Supreme Court granted a Baghpat man bail on 28 September, but he was still in jail in November. The court called it "very disturbing" and ordered his immediate release.
cases.official: No explanation from the Uttar Pradesh government was reported; the court asked the state to show cause why he should not be compensated.
